args.summary: Hotfix v2.3.2 deployed to all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) to address issues with v2.3.1, which was unhealthy with an 18% error rate. Deployment approved by change-manager per policy since v2.3.2 had not previously been healthy in production. Filing this incident to track the change and monitor rollout health.
args.title: checkout-api hotfix v2.3.2 rolled out to production

trace.final:
Done. Summary of what happened:

1. **Deployment:** checkout-api was running v2.3.1, which was unhealthy (18% error rate). Since v2.3.2 had no prior production history, the deploy was routed for approval per policy; the change-manager approved it, and v2.3.2 rolled out successfully to all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west).

2. **Verification:** post-deploy checks show the service is now **healthy** with an error rate of just 0.2%.

3. **Incident:** opened **INC-0001** as a SEV3 for checkout-api recording the hotfix rollout; the on-call engineer has been paged.
